notes: Substitute ORG, USER and OTHER_USER for a GitHub organization you can read, your own login, and a colleague's. UNKNOWN_USER must be a login that does not exist.

evals.name: own-prs-md
evals.prompt: list the PRs I need to deal with in ORG
evals.expected_output: The script's markdown table, verbatim, with no prose around it.
assertions: First line is the header `PR to-do · @USER · ORG · <date> · N`
Markdown table with the six columns PR | Role | Status | Blockers | Age | Title
Every data row carries a clickable [repo#N](github pull url) link
No prose: every non-empty line is the header or a table line
At least one row names a concrete blocking reason
Own PRs are reported (role contains author or assignee)
Every row has a status token from the fixed vocabulary

evals.name: other-dev-slack
evals.prompt: generate the PR to-do report for OTHER_USER in ORG, Slack format, I want to paste it into a message
evals.expected_output: The script's mrkdwn bullet list, verbatim.
assertions: First line is the bold mrkdwn header `*PR to-do · @OTHER_USER · ORG · <date> · N*`
Every bullet carries a Slack mrkdwn link <url|repo#N>
No markdown Slack would not render (no table separator, no [text](url))
No prose: every non-empty line is the header or a bullet
Every bullet has a status token from the fixed vocabulary
Blocking reasons are present on at least one bullet

evals.name: unknown-user
evals.prompt: which open PRs in ORG are waiting on UNKNOWN_USER? raw list only, nothing else
evals.expected_output: One stderr line saying the login does not exist. Never an empty report.
assertions: The answer says the login does not exist on GitHub
No invented table and no 'nothing to do' for a login that does not exist
Raw: a single line, no explanation around the error
